summary:
Implementation plan to:
1. Give the Floating Bottom Menu Bar a pill-shaped container with fully rounded corners, tonal surface styling, and subtle border.
2. Fix Monet theming to use system dynamic wallpaper colors without Wada palette overriding, while Standard uses the baseline palette.
3. Update App Icon to the Looks double-arc icon with #FFDBFE background and #000000 icon, including Android 13+ Themed/Minimalist icon support.
4. Add the Looks icon to the top-left of the Match screen in black (light mode) or white (dark mode).
